ns2:section.sectionText: This is the discussion/recitation section of the course that meets face-to-face on the Urbana campus. Webcasts, course materials, and a discussion board will be made available online through Illinois Compass. Students are expected to take course exams and complete online assignments on ACE Organic as outlined in the syllabus. Students must report to campus or to an approved off-site testing center for all exams. Discussion sessions will be conducted online using Elluminate Live! at the indicated times. Students enrolled in the face-to-face section will be provided PCs for use with Elluminate Live!; it is strongly recommended that all students bring their own microphone headsets to class. Discussion sessions will be recorded and archived online for later review."
